    People

    Who sits on the Student Council, Tha Prachan, and what each person does, with the document behind every role.

    Published by
    Thammasat University Student Council, Tha Prachan (TUSC)
    Position as at
    19 March 2026 (the latest meeting in the data)
    Last updated
    31 October 2026
    Next update
    To be announced
    Contact
    TUSC secretariat team, Tha Prachan [shared address to be confirmed]

    Names are shown as printed in the documents. Where no document gives a Latin spelling, [Latin spelling not stated] is shown. The President of the Student Council, Tha Prachan, is not the President of the Student Council of Thammasat University (all campuses).

    Contents

    1. Main points
    2. President and executive committee
    3. Offices and assistant secretaries-general
    4. Council members
    5. Seats by party
    6. Everyone named
    7. Source documents

    Main points

    • The documents name 54 people across 13 committees and offices.
    • The council has 30 seats, as recorded at its latest meeting.
    • The Rector's announcement of 8 May 2025 names 30 members of the council at Tha Prachan.
    • The executive committee table lists 14 posts and their holders.
